summary: Checked all 51 produce entries on the five points; 50 ids were already byte-verified and I re-fetched only the suspect/candidate ones. Fruit rows are all plain raw FNDDS items with sane numbers (banana 97, apple 61, avocado 160; grapes 83 is FNDDS/Foundation-current vs SR 69 — flagged as borderline, not wrong). Wrong: Cherry tomatoes (321360 is a withdrawn Foundation id; USDA has no SR/FNDDS cherry or grape tomato — search returns only branded rows, and 1999634 is roma) -> REMOVE and fold aliases into Tomato (20 vs 27 kcal). Zucchini cooked half was 'yellow or green' summer squash -> replaced with the SR zucchini-only pair 169291/169292. Bell pepper SR-red-boiled cooked half is fine. Alias fixes: 'sprouts' (Brussels) and 'salad' (romaine) hijack searches; 'baby carrots' routed to 44-kcal carrots when SR has a 35-kcal baby-carrot item (now its own entry); added green/yellow pepper and frozen peas aliases. Defaults (raw for spinach/carrot/pepper/onion, cooked for broccoli/asparagus/brussels etc.) are sensible; kale-cooked is a coin flip (43 vs 46 kcal). Single-half fruit/veg rows live in the 'cooked' slot with raw=null and no default — structural, not a data error. Added 8 verified entries: frozen mixed berries, canned corn, baby carrots, unsweetened applesauce, spring mix, butternut squash (SR raw/baked pair), beets (FNDDS pair), sugar snap peas. Also verified but left out for the 8-cap: Pomegranate 2709267 (83 kcal) and jalapeno SR 168576 (29 kcal). Not resolved: no clean 'frozen broccoli' distinction (frozen cooked ~28 vs fresh 41 kcal) — left as a note. Requests used: 35.
